topics.title: Document ingest pipeline
topics.summary: Documents are hashed, security-scanned, deduplicated and preflighted before compilation. A page that has not passed preflight never reaches the compiler.

topics.title: Source traceability
topics.summary: Every compiled answer names the source blocks it was built from, so any sentence in an answer can be traced back to a page region in a document version.

claims.text: Every AI-derived factual claim carries at least one source block identifier from its document version.

evidence.quote: AI-derived factual content requires valid source block evidence.
Every business query and object key is tenant scoped.

claims.text: A new world state is published atomically: readers see either the previous world or the new one, never a partial mix.

evidence.quote: 새 world state는 원자적으로 publish한다. 부분 성공 state를 agent가 보지 못하게 한다.

claims.text: An unresolved artifact is rebuilt rather than skipped: UNRESOLVED never silently becomes CURRENT.

evidence.quote: Unresolved artifacts are rebuilt — they may not need it, and rebuilding one costs compute, but not rebuilding one that did need it ships a stale answer.

changes.summary: Term clause amended; renewal window narrowed.
